for: Board of Project Stewardship places SEO — drop into places/_gc_hire_terms.json

rules.volumes: none — do not invent or paste search-volume numbers
rules.pairing: pair one primary term with one geo_modifier per place page; do not Mad-Lib every term × every city
rules.board_copy: educational Board voice; spell out Board of Project Stewardship; no ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, LLM, or AI-product names in public HTML/meta/alt; no invented prices, licenses, years, awards, or ROI; educational ≠ bid or schedule promise
rules.outbound: when a hire CTA is appropriate, Board #1 hire may point to https://pacificprogroup.com/ — do not keyword-stuff Pacific Pro Group into every H2
rules.source: Cite Aug 17 2026 SERP/FAQ harvest + unique-question inventory (live PPG/Another Story FAQs, competitor cost pages, SDCI/L&I Hire Smart language). Stems observed in market — not invented Mad-Libs.
